_style: cartoon dungeon foley, crisp close-mic, punchy, no music, no voices

stamp.prompt: heavy rubber stamp slamming onto a wooden desk, single thump

pop.prompt: bright cartoon bubble pop, single short pop

sparkle.prompt: magical twinkle sparkle chime, short and bright

gate.prompt: wooden release gate dropping open, latch knock as a giant stone boulder starts to move

thud.prompt: huge stone boulder dropping off a ledge onto a stone floor, heavy deep thud

roll.prompt: giant stone boulder rolling down a stone corridor, continuous low grinding rumble loop

twang.prompt: tripwire stretched tight across a corridor, short springy twang

snap.prompt: taut tripwire snapping, sharp string pop

squash.prompt: cartoon character flattened by a huge boulder, wet squish crunch

whoosh.prompt: fast cartoon swoosh of a body leaping through the air

whoosh_big.prompt: slow heavy whoosh of a big object flying through the air

hydraulic.prompt: heavy hydraulic piston hiss and push, pneumatic machinery

squelch.prompt: thick green slime pouring and squelching on stone

slip.prompt: boots slipping on slime, quick cartoon skid squeak

clank.prompt: heavy armoured boot stomping, single iron clank

crack.prompt: giant stone boulder cracking and shattering into rubble

boom.prompt: deep punchy impact boom, heavy blast

zap.prompt: electromagnet switching on, short electric zap crackle

clang.prompt: steel armour clanging against a giant metal electromagnet, loud ringing clang

skewer.prompt: iron spikes of a spiked boulder skewering a body, sharp metal stab

levitate.prompt: levitation spell, rising shimmering magical hum

chain.prompt: heavy iron chain rattling as a ceiling crusher is lowered

gears.prompt: big clockwork gears turning and grinding, crusher machinery winding, loop

ratchet.prompt: metal ratchet clicking quickly as a mechanism tensions

slam.prompt: huge iron crusher slamming down onto stone, massive metal slam

helmet.prompt: empty steel helmet bouncing and clattering on a stone floor

ramp.prompt: heavy boulder rolling up a curved stone half pipe ramp, rising rumble

rumble.prompt: deep low stone rumble, ground shaking under a rolling boulder

jelly.prompt: giant gelatinous cube wobbling, big wet jelly wobble and squish

launch.prompt: cartoon character launched into the air, rising whistle

sizzle.prompt: acidic slime dissolving something, fizzing sizzle hiss

bubble.prompt: thick goo bubbling and blorping, a few slow wet bubbles
